description: Representative review prompts for deterministic coverage checks, not a model-behavior benchmark.

cases.prompt: A patch returns a successful response before the transaction commits, so a later commit failure is reported as success. Review the change.
A pull request only changes whitespace and formatter output, and the formatter check is green. Review the change.
A patch meets the stated requirement. A reviewer wonders whether a hypothetical future tenant model might need a different abstraction, but no such path exists today.
A small local behavior change is correct and covered. The reviewer proposes replacing the module with a new event-driven architecture without a requirement or execution path.
A bug fix changes authorization behavior, but the pull request has no reproducible regression test or equivalent verification for the rejected-user case.
The patch matches the acceptance criteria, preserves the boundary conditions, and has proportionate passing tests. Review the change.
